title: Why I Built Meridian Performance
excerpt: I didn't become a coach because fitness always came easily to me. Meridian Performance was built from my own experience with change, discipline and the belief that the right system can help people reach a level they didn't think was possible.
author: chance-dyck

seo.title: Why I Built Meridian Performance | Personal Training in Del Mar
seo.description: Chance Dyck shares why he built Meridian Performance and his approach to personal training, nutrition, accountability and long-term progress in Del Mar, CA.
